title: [Concerning the Advent of Five Fathers from the Five Limbs of the Father]

lines.english: Once again the Apostle spoke concerning {29}

lines.coptic: {30} ⲙ̄ⲡⲓⲱⲧ ⲟⲩⲉ ⲛⲥⲁ ⲟⲩⲉ ⲡⲁⲭⲉ{31} ⲙ̄{32}ⲧⲉ ⲭⲉ {33}
lines.english: {30} the Father, one after another. He said {32} in this manner: '{33}
{34} from his mind, the Beloved of the Lights;
{35} the Mother of Life; from his teaching {36}
the Beloved; from his counsel, the Virgin of Light; {37}

lines.coptic: ⲃⲁⲗ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉϩⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ Ⲧϩⲉ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉⲓ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲧⲱϩⲙ̄{38}
lines.english: from his reflection.' Thus then is the manner in which they were called forth, {38}

lines.coptic: ⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⳨⳨ⲉ ⲛ̄ⲟⲓⲛⲉⲓ ⲁⲩⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲙⲡ⳨ⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲉⲗⲟⲥ {39}
lines.english: Fathers — in this coming they came forth from the Five Members {39}

lines.coptic: ⲟⲩⲉ ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲛⲟⲩⲉ ⲁϩⲟⲱⲗⲡ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ϩⲙ̄ ⲡⲉϩⲕⲁⲗⲣⲟⲥ
lines.english: one came forth from another, and was revealed forth from his lot.
